_comment: Sponsor slots. Prices are reserve (minimum) bids in USD; people bid above them on /advertise.html. Live bids and clocks live in the auction Worker (worker/), which bundles this file, so redeploy it after changing a figure. A sponsor set here renders in that slot; a null sponsor renders the live auction card.

lifetime.label: Lifetime sponsor
lifetime.position: Top of the sidebar, above the fold on every screen.

header.label: Header strip
header.position: Slim text line under the hero, above search.

rail.label: Right rail
rail.position: Sidebar, directly under the lifetime sponsor.

footer.label: Footer row
footer.position: One of three units above the site footer.
